jobs.title: Berater (w/m/d) Private Banking Olten
jobs.description:
Wir sind die Bank von Helvetia - einem innovativen Finanzdienstleister, der Banking und Versicherung intelligent verbindet. Gemeinsam neue Massstäbe setzen und die Zukunft gestalten – das bedeutet für uns mehr, als Aufgaben einfach abzuarbeiten. Hier arbeitest du mit Menschen zusammen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, hohe Ansprüche haben und den Mut mitbringen, neue Wege zu gehen. Bei uns findest du ein Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen und Leistung Hand in Hand gehen und deine Ideen, deine Initiative und dein Beitrag zählen. So hast du die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden, dein Team und deine persönliche Entwicklung.

Aufgaben:
• Du betreust und berätst unsere Private Banking Kundinnen und Kunden ganzheitlich und bedürfnisorientiert und positionierst dich als vertrauensvolle Ansprechperson in allen Finanzfragen. Dabei unterstützt du sie bei der Gestaltung ihrer finanziellen Zukunft und empfiehlst passende Anlage- und Vorsorgelösungen.

• Du analysierst die Bedürfnisse deiner Kundinnen und Kunden unter Berücksichtigung ihrer individuellen Wünsche, Ziele und Lebenssituationen. Bei Bedarf arbeitest du eng mit internen Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten zusammen und entwickelst passende Anlagelösungen.

• Gemeinsam mit internen Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten der Bank und der Versicherung erarbeitest du individuelle Anlage-, Vorsorge-, Finanzierungs- und Nachfolgekonzepte.

• Du gewinnst aktiv neue Private Banking Kundinnen und Kunden und entwickelst dein Kundenportfolio im Anlagebereich kontinuierlich weiter.

• Du erkennst zusätzliche Beratungsmöglichkeiten und nutzt diese gezielt durch aktives Cross-Selling. Dabei berätst du deine Kundinnen und Kunden umfassend zu Bank- und Versicherungsprodukten.

• Du beobachtest die Entwicklungen an den Finanzmärkten und besprichst diese regelmässig mit deinen Kundinnen und Kunden.

• An Kundenanlässen repräsentierst du unser Private Banking nach innen und aussen.

Anforderungen:
• Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Betreuung und Beratung von Private Banking Kundinnen und Kunden.

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene Bankausbildung sowie eine Weiterbildung, zum Beispiel Finanzplaner:in mit eidgenössischem Fachausweis oder einen Bachelor in Banking and Finance.

• Du bist eine empathische und authentische Persönlichkeit und verstehst es, unseren Private Banking Kundinnen und Kunden in unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen ein überzeugendes Kundenerlebnis zu bieten.

• Du bist eine engagierte, unternehmerisch denkende und integre Persönlichkeit mit hohen Qualitätsanspruch und ausgeprägter Kundenorientierung.

• Dein Teamgeist sowie dein sicheres und gewinnendes Auftreten runden dein Profil ab.

• Dank deiner regionalen Verwurzelung und deines bestehenden Netzwerks kennst du die lokalen Gegebenheiten und verfügst über wertvolle Kontakte in der Region.

Wir glauben an Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen wollen. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven helfen uns, bessere Lösungen zu entwickeln - für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden genauso wie für uns als Team.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Siamo la banca di Helvetia – un innovativo fornitore di servizi finanziari che combina intelligentemente banche e assicurazioni. Impostare nuovi standard insieme e modellare il futuro – per noi, questo significa più che semplicemente lavorare attraverso i compiti. Qui si lavora con le persone che si prendono la responsabilità, hanno richieste elevate e hanno il coraggio di andare nuove strade. Con noi, troverete un ambiente in cui la fiducia e le prestazioni vanno di pari passo e le vostre idee, l'iniziativa e il conteggio dei contributi. Quindi avete la possibilità di fare davvero la differenza per i nostri clienti, il vostro team e il vostro sviluppo personale.

Compiti:
• Sostiene e consiglia i nostri clienti bancari privati in modo olistico e orientato al bisogno e si posiziona come persona di contatto affidabile in tutte le questioni finanziarie. Li supporti nella modellazione del loro futuro finanziario e raccomanda soluzioni di investimento e pensione adeguate.

• Analizzi le esigenze dei tuoi clienti, tenendo conto dei loro desideri individuali, degli obiettivi e delle situazioni di vita. Se necessario, lavorerai a stretto contatto con specialisti interni e svilupperai soluzioni di investimento adatte.

• Insieme a specialisti interni della banca e della compagnia assicurativa, svilupperai concetti di investimento individuale, pensione, finanziamento e successione.

• Acquisrai attivamente nuovi clienti bancari privati e svilupperai continuamente il tuo portafoglio di clienti nel settore degli investimenti.

• Riconosci ulteriori opportunità di consulenza e li usi specificamente attraverso cross-selling attivo. Fornisci consigli completi ai tuoi clienti sui prodotti bancari e assicurativi.

• Osservate gli sviluppi sui mercati finanziari e discuteteli regolarmente con i vostri clienti.

• In occasione del cliente, rappresentate il nostro private banking dentro e fuori.

Requisiti
• Hai diversi anni di esperienza nel sostenere e consigliare i clienti bancari privati.

• Hai una formazione bancaria completa e un'ulteriore formazione, per esempio pianificatore finanziario:in con un certificato professionale federale o un Bachelor in Banking e Finanza.

• Sei una personalità empatica e autentica e capisci come offrire ai nostri clienti di private banking un'esperienza clienti convincente in diverse situazioni di vita.

• Sei una personalità impegnata, imprenditoriale e integrita' con elevati standard qualitativi e forte orientamento al cliente.

• Il vostro spirito di squadra così come il vostro aspetto sicuro e vincente intorno al vostro profilo.

• Grazie alle vostre radici regionali e alla vostra rete esistente, conoscete le condizioni locali e avete contatti preziosi nella regione.

Crediamo nella cooperazione in termini uguali, fiducia reciproca e persone che vogliono assumersi la responsabilità. Prospettive diverse ci aiutano a sviluppare soluzioni migliori – per i nostri clienti e per noi come team.
descriptionByLocale.en:
We are the bank of Helvetia – an innovative financial services provider that intelligently combines banking and insurance. Setting new standards together and shaping the future – for us, this means more than simply working through tasks. Here you work with people who take responsibility, have high demands and have the courage to go new ways. With us, you will find an environment where trust and performance go hand in hand and your ideas, initiative and contribution count. So you have the opportunity to really make a difference for our customers, your team and your personal development.

Tasks:
• You support and advise our private banking customers holistically and need-oriented and position yourself as a trusted contact person in all financial matters. You support them in shaping their financial future and recommend suitable investment and pension solutions.

• You analyze the needs of your customers, taking into account their individual wishes, goals and life situations. If necessary, you will work closely with internal specialists and develop suitable investment solutions.

• Together with internal specialists from the bank and the insurance company, you will develop individual investment, pension, financing and succession concepts.

• You will actively gain new private banking clients and continuously develop your portfolio of clients in the investment sector.

• You recognize additional consulting opportunities and use them specifically through active cross-selling. You provide comprehensive advice to your customers on banking and insurance products.

• You observe the developments on the financial markets and discuss them regularly with your customers.

• On customer occasions, you represent our private banking inside and out.

Requirements
• You have several years of experience in supporting and advising private banking customers.

• You have a completed banking education as well as a further education, for example financial planner:in with a federal professional certificate or a Bachelor in Banking and Finance.

• You are an empathetic and authentic personality and understand how to offer our private banking customers a compelling customer experience in different life situations.

• You are a committed, entrepreneurial and integrity-minded personality with high quality standards and strong customer orientation.

• Your team spirit as well as your safe and winning appearance round off your profile.

• Thanks to your regional roots and your existing network, you know the local conditions and have valuable contacts in the region.

We believe in cooperation on equal terms, mutual trust and people who want to take responsibility. Different perspectives help us to develop better solutions – for our customers as well as for us as a team.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous sommes la banque d'Helvetia – un fournisseur de services financiers innovant qui combine intelligemment banque et assurance. Établir de nouvelles normes ensemble et façonner l'avenir – pour nous, cela signifie plus que simplement travailler à travers les tâches. Ici, vous travaillez avec des gens qui prennent des responsabilités, qui ont des exigences élevées et qui ont le courage d'aller de nouvelles façons. Avec nous, vous trouverez un environnement où la confiance et la performance vont de pair et vos idées, initiatives et contributions comptent. Vous avez donc la possibilité de vraiment faire une différence pour nos clients, votre équipe et votre développement personnel.

Tâches :
• Vous aidez et conseillez nos clients de services bancaires privés de façon holistique et axée sur les besoins et vous positionnez vous-même comme une personne de confiance dans toutes les questions financières. Vous les aidez à façonner leur avenir financier et vous recommandez des solutions d'investissement et de retraite appropriées.

• Vous analysez les besoins de vos clients en tenant compte de leurs souhaits, de leurs objectifs et de leurs situations de vie. Si nécessaire, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des spécialistes internes et développerez des solutions d'investissement appropriées.

• Avec des spécialistes internes de la banque et de la compagnie d'assurance, vous développerez des concepts d'investissement individuel, de retraite, de financement et de succession.

• Vous obtiendrez activement de nouveaux clients de la banque privée et développerez continuellement votre portefeuille de clients dans le secteur des investissements.

• Vous reconnaissez d'autres possibilités de consultation et les utilisez spécifiquement par le biais de ventes croisées actives. Vous fournissez des conseils complets à vos clients sur les produits bancaires et d'assurance.

• Vous observez l'évolution des marchés financiers et en discutez régulièrement avec vos clients.

• À l'occasion, vous représentez notre banque privée à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur.

Exigences
• Vous avez plusieurs années d'expérience dans le soutien et le conseil de clients de banque privée.

• Vous avez une formation bancaire complétée ainsi qu'une formation complémentaire, par exemple planificateur financier:avec un certificat professionnel fédéral ou un baccalauréat en banque et finances.

• Vous êtes une personnalité empathique et authentique et comprenez comment offrir à nos clients de banque privée une expérience client convaincante dans différentes situations de vie.

• Vous êtes une personnalité engagée, entrepreneuriale et intègre avec des normes de qualité élevées et une forte orientation client.

• Votre esprit d'équipe ainsi que votre apparence sûre et gagnante complètent votre profil.

• Grâce à vos racines régionales et à votre réseau existant, vous connaissez les conditions locales et avez des contacts précieux dans la région.

Nous croyons à la coopération dans des conditions d'égalité, à la confiance mutuelle et aux personnes qui veulent assumer leurs responsabilités. Différentes perspectives nous aident à développer de meilleures solutions, tant pour nos clients que pour nous en tant qu'équipe.

- Sei una persona impegnata e intraprendente con integrità, elevati standard di qualità e un forte orientamento al cliente.
- Il tuo spirito di squadra e il tuo atteggiamento fiducioso e vincente completano il tuo profilo.

Offriamo

descriptionByLocale.en:
Description
We are the bank of Helvetia - an innovative financial service provider that intelligently combines banking and insurance. Setting new standards together and shaping the future – that means more to us than simply completing tasks. Here you work with people who take responsibility, have high standards and have the courage to break new ground. With us you will find an environment where trust and performance go hand in hand and where your ideas, your initiative and your contribution count. This gives you the opportunity to really make a difference for our customers, your team and your personal development.

Tasks
- You actively acquire new private banking customers and continuously develop an existing customer portfolio in the investment sector.
- You support and advise our customers holistically and in a needs-oriented manner and position yourself as a trustworthy contact person for all financial questions. You will support them in shaping their financial future and recommend suitable investment and pension solutions.
- You analyze the needs of your customers, taking into account their individual wishes, goals and life situations. If necessary, you will work closely with internal specialists and develop suitable investment solutions.
- Together with internal specialists, you will develop individual investment, pension, financing and succession concepts.
- You recognize additional consulting opportunities and use them specifically through active cross-selling. You will provide your customers with comprehensive advice on banking and insurance products.
- You monitor developments on the financial markets and discuss them regularly with your customers.
- At customer events you represent our private banking internally and externally.

Requirements
- You have several years of experience in supporting and advising private banking customers.
- You have completed banking training and further training; for example, a financial planner with a federal certificate or a bachelor's degree in banking and finance.
- You are an empathetic and authentic personality and know how to offer our private banking customers a convincing customer experience in different life situations.
- You are a committed, entrepreneurial person with integrity and high quality standards and a strong customer orientation.
- Your team spirit as well as your confident and winning demeanor complete your profile.

We offer
- We believe in cooperation on equal terms, mutual trust and people who want to take responsibility. Different perspectives help us to develop better solutions - for our customers as well as for us as a team.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Siamo la banca di Helvetia – un innovativo fornitore di servizi finanziari che combina intelligentemente banche e assicurazioni. Impostare nuovi standard insieme e modellare il futuro – per noi, questo significa più che semplicemente lavorare attraverso i compiti. Qui si lavora con le persone che si prendono la responsabilità, hanno richieste elevate e hanno il coraggio di andare nuove strade. Con noi, troverete un ambiente in cui la fiducia e le prestazioni vanno di pari passo e le vostre idee, l'iniziativa e il conteggio dei contributi. Quindi avete la possibilità di fare davvero la differenza per i nostri clienti, il vostro team e il vostro sviluppo personale

Compiti:
Unisciti al nostro team di gestione delle applicazioni di Baloise Bank e aiutaci a sviluppare e mantenere soluzioni di integrazione innovative.
Condividi le tue idee, essere curioso e implementare progetti IT in stretta collaborazione con specialisti IT e il business.

Con un focus su Avaloq, il team di gestione delle applicazioni di Baloise Bank è responsabile del buon funzionamento di tutte le applicazioni IT. Stiamo cercando di rafforzare il nostro team nel funzionamento dell'applicazione del nostro sistema bancario core (Avaloq), i sistemi circostanti e progetti di integrazione.

• Analisi, progettazione e realizzazione di progetti di integrazione tra Avaloq e vari ambienti

• Una stretta collaborazione con reparti, team IT e partner esterni

• Parametrizzazione, configurazione e sviluppo continuo del sistema bancario Avaloq

• Funzionamento, manutenzione e ottimizzazione della piattaforma di integrazione e delle soluzioni di interfaccia

• Garantire operazioni di applicazione stabili tra cui monitoraggio, gestione degli incidenti e dei problemi

• Collaborazione in supporto di secondo livello e realizzazione di compiti di pulizia e gestione del ciclo di vita

• Supporto per le recensioni di sicurezza, concetti di autorizzazione, correzioni di vulnerabilità e l'implementazione dei principi di sicurezza-by-design

• Partecipazione attiva allo sviluppo tecnico e organizzativo del nostro paesaggio di applicazione

Requisiti
• Laurea superiore in informatica, informatica aziendale o formazione comparabile

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nell'ambiente bancario

• Conoscenza approfondita del sistema bancario Avaloq

• Buona conoscenza degli ambienti di database Windows, Linux e SQL, esperienza con le tecnologie dei container come Docker o OpenShift

• Metodo di lavoro analitico, strutturato e indipendente

• Godetevi la cooperazione interdisciplinare e lo scambio con diversi stakeholder

• Conoscenza molto buona del tedesco e buona conoscenza dell'inglese

Crediamo nella cooperazione in termini uguali, di fiducia reciproca e di persone che vogliono assumersi la responsabilità. Prospettive diverse ci aiutano a sviluppare soluzioni migliori – per i nostri clienti e per noi come team.
descriptionByLocale.en:
We are the bank of Helvetia – an innovative financial services provider that intelligently combines banking and insurance. Setting new standards together and shaping the future – for us, this means more than simply working through tasks. Here you work with people who take responsibility, have high demands and have the courage to go new ways. With us, you will find an environment where trust and performance go hand in hand and your ideas, initiative and contribution count. So you have the opportunity to really make a difference for our customers, your team and your personal development

Tasks:
Join our application management team at Baloise Bank and help us develop and maintain innovative integration solutions.
Share your ideas, be curious and implement IT projects in close cooperation with IT specialists and the business.

With a focus on Avaloq, Baloise Bank’s application management team is responsible for the smooth operation of all IT applications. We are looking for you to strengthen our team in the application operation of our core banking system (Avaloq), the surrounding systems and integration projects.

• Analysis, design and implementation of integration projects between Avaloq and various environments

• Close cooperation with departments, IT teams and external partners

• Parameterization, configuration and continuous development of the Avaloq Banking System

• Operation, maintenance and optimization of the integration platform and interface solutions

• Ensuring stable application operations including monitoring, incident and problem management

• Collaboration in 2nd-level support and implementation of housekeeping and lifecycle management tasks

• Support for security reviews, authorization concepts, vulnerability fixes and the implementation of security-by-design principles

• Active participation in the technical and organizational development of our application landscape

Requirements
• Higher degree in computer science, business informatics or comparable training

• Several years of professional experience in the banking environment

• In-depth knowledge of the Avaloq Banking System

• Good knowledge of Windows, Linux and SQL database environments, experience with container technologies such as Docker or OpenShift

• Analytical, structured and independent working method

• Enjoy interdisciplinary cooperation and exchange with different stakeholders

• Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English

We believe in cooperation on equal terms, mutual trust and people who want to take responsibility. Different perspectives help us to develop better solutions – for our customers as well as for us as a team.
